compiled:
📰 General

Jaguars Dominate Ravens in Thursday Night Football Thriller – 33-10

The Jacksonville Jaguars secured a decisive 33-10 victory over the Baltimore Ravens on Thursday night. The Jaguars’ performance was marked by a strong offensive showing and a dominant defensive effort. Baltimore’s game was significantly impacted by injuries to starting quarterback Lamar Jackson and backup Tyler Huntley. Jacksonville improved to 6-2, while the Ravens dropped to 4-5 with the loss.

🌍 World

Trump’s Envoy Presents Five-Point Plan for European Security Framework •

Jared Kushner, US President Donald Trump’s senior advisor, presented a five-point framework for a European security architecture during discussions preceding planned US-mediated talks between Ukraine and Russia. The plan focuses on establishing a demilitarized zone along the border between Ukraine and Russia, guaranteeing Ukraine’s neutrality, and ensuring Russia’s security concerns are addressed. Kushner emphasized the importance of a comprehensive framework to facilitate a lasting peace agreement. The initiative aims to create a stable environment for negotiations and address key security issues impacting the region.

🦅 US

Nithya Raman Unseats Mayor Bass in Historic Los Angeles Election Victory •

Nithya Raman has secured the mayoral seat in Los Angeles, marking the first time a challenger has defeated an incumbent mayor in over twenty years. The final election results, released on Thursday, confirmed Raman’s win following a concession call from Mayor Karen Bass. The victory represents a significant shift in Los Angeles politics and a rejection of the current administration’s policies. Initial projections indicated a close race, but Raman ultimately prevailed with a decisive margin.

💰 Business

Texas Governor Halts Data Center Development Pending Benefit to Residents •

Governor Greg Abbott announced a temporary halt to all new data center construction within the state of Texas. This decision follows concerns raised about the impact of data centers on rural communities and the overall economic benefits for Texans. The governor stated that data center developers must demonstrate a clear commitment to providing tangible advantages for local residents before any further projects can proceed. This action represents a significant shift in policy regarding the rapid expansion of data centers previously permitted in the state.

💻 Technology

Nintendo Confirms Continued Zelda Celebrations Ahead of Switch 2 Release •

Nintendo continues to mark the 40th anniversary of the Legend of Zelda franchise following the recent launch of Ocarina of Time on the Switch 2. The company is focused on celebrating the series’ milestone with new content and initiatives. Details regarding specific plans remain limited, but Nintendo has emphasized the ongoing significance of Zelda within its portfolio. This anniversary celebration is occurring alongside the release of a highly anticipated title for the console.

🎭 Entertainment

Warner Bros. Exit Fuels Concerns as Hollywood Sees Wave of Female Executive Departures •

Following her removal as head of Warner Bros. Discovery’s entertainment division, Pamela Abdy discussed the recent trend of female executives leaving high-level positions within the industry. At the Women in Film Honors, Abdy acknowledged a period of reflection after the unexpected departure. She attributed the trend to a challenging environment and a lack of clear career progression opportunities for women in leadership roles. The situation underscores ongoing questions about diversity and retention within Hollywood’s major studios.

🏅 Sports

LSU Tigers Shatter Division I Record with Dominating 131-22 Victory •

LSU’s women’s basketball team recorded a historic performance on Thursday, defeating Texas Southern 131-22. The Tigers established a Division I record for largest margin of victory, showcasing a dominant offensive display. The game marked the second contest of the season for LSU, highlighting the team’s early-season momentum. Texas Southern finished with a score of 22 points, significantly trailing the Tigers’ 131.

🔬 Science

NASA Offers Public “Hitch-Ride” to Saturn’s Largest Moon – A Unique Opportunity •

NASA is offering a limited number of individuals the chance to participate in a mission to Titan, Saturn’s largest moon. The program, dubbed “Hitch-Ride,” will allow selected participants to travel alongside scientific instruments aboard the upcoming Dragonfly rotorcraft lander. Dragonfly will explore Titan’s surface, searching for prebiotic chemistry and potential signs of life. The mission is expected to launch in 2027 and will utilize a modular design for increased scientific return.

🩺 Health

Bird Flu Confirmed in Pierce County Poultry Facility – Public Health Monitoring Underway •

The Washington State Department of Agriculture has confirmed the presence of avian influenza, commonly known as bird flu, at a commercial poultry facility in Pierce County. This marks the first detection of the virus within the state for the current year. No human infections have been reported related to the outbreak at the facility. Public health agencies are actively monitoring the situation and investigating the source of the infection. Authorities are advising against contact with sick or dead birds.
